title: Tourism Product Development: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
school: School of Hospitality Travel and Tourism Management
programme: Bachelor of Travel and Tourism Management

parts.text: Identify the management and co-ordination priorities, which a destination ought to pursue.
Enumerate challenges associated with tourism product development among growing economics like Kenya.
Describe the elements of the tourism product.

items.text: Section B ANSWER ANY TWO QUESTIONS
Changing market conditions require changes of tourism products. Describe, the new or reshaped tourism product development trends at the global level.
Discuss the fundamental issues affecting global tourism product development and marketing planning.
Describe the application of the destination life cycle expounding on adaptability of tourism products beyond seasons.
Using an illustration discuss the application and implication of destination lifecycle which describes how a destination undergoes a cycle of evolution.
